description: Open local workspaces and inspect read-only infrastructure graphs.
view.resources.welcome: Open a folder with [CloudForge: Open Workspace](command:cloudforge.openWorkspace) to inspect its resources.
command.saveStudio: Save Studio Changes to Terraform Files
config.editor.codeLens: Show inline CloudForge Canvas and resource actions above Terraform blocks.
config.plan.useLinkedCloudAccounts: Run Plan with the project's linked cloud accounts (after checking each one's sign-in) when the architecture uses that cloud. Turn off to always plan credential-free.
config.startup.preload: After the window opens, load provider schemas and check this architecture's providers in the background so Studio forms and Get Ready are instant. Progress shows in the status bar.
config.projects.openInNewWindow: Controls whether opening or creating a CloudForge project while another folder is open uses a new window, replaces the current window, or asks.

command.importMirrorPackage: Import Provider Archive (.zip) into Local Mirror…
command.evictMirrorPackage: Remove Package from Local Provider Mirror…
view.projects.welcome:
Clone a repository into a CloudForge project:
[GitHub](command:cloudforge.cloneRepository?%5B%22github%22%5D)
[GitLab](command:cloudforge.cloneRepository?%5B%22gitlab%22%5D)
[Bitbucket](command:cloudforge.cloneRepository?%5B%22bitbucket%22%5D)
[Any Git URL](command:cloudforge.cloneRepository?%5B%22url%22%5D)
Or [create a project](command:cloudforge.createProject).

config.ai.autoDiscoverLocal: Automatically detect locally running Ollama (127.0.0.1:11434) and LM Studio (127.0.0.1:1234) models for VS Code Chat and Agent View.
config.ai.providers: Custom or overridden AI model provider endpoints (HTTPS or local loopback HTTP). API keys are stored encrypted in OS SecretStorage and never in settings.json.
config.ai.customModels: Custom local or remote AI models surfaced directly in VS Code's Chat and Agent View model picker.
command.scanLocalModels: Scan Local AI Models (Ollama / LM Studio)
chat.description: Build multi-cloud topologies, browse baked-in CloudForge skills, and review architecture proposals.
chat.command.topology: List or scaffold a customized multi-cloud starter blueprint as a reviewable proposal.
chat.command.skills: Inspect baked-in CloudForge diagram, topology, workflow, and Terraform skills.
chat.command.explain: Explain a resource type using saved architecture notes and guidance.
chat.command.proposals: Inspect pending AI and blueprint proposals for the active architecture.
